  "phoneNote": "The burgundy palette and serif typography suit a traditional brivnica, but the navigation overlays the hero heading and description in the full-page view.",
  "desktopNote": "The photographic hero feels composed and trade-specific, but oversized section padding and the sparse price grid make the rest of the page unnecessarily long.",

  "fixes": [
    "Correct the phone navigation positioning so the brand and action rows never obscure the hero heading or description.",
    "Reduce desktop section padding, especially around opening hours and the story, and arrange the five prices in a balanced grid or compact service list.",
    "Give the story section a more barber-specific visual focus; the large street image currently contributes more atmosphere than information about the craft."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone, hero in the full-page view: the navigation covers the headline and part of the description."
  ]
